name: Kerala-leaning coconut crema (coconut, curry leaf, tamarind, lime)
status: PRELIMINARY ESTIMATE — NOT COOKED OR TASTED
shelf_life_note: 3 days at ≤ 5 °C (ASSUMPTION: set by a food-safety professional)
method: Pop mustard seed and fry curry leaf in the oil; add ginger and chile, then turmeric.
Add coconut milk and tamarind; simmer gently 10 min (do not boil hard); cool.
Blend smooth, add lime and salt; chill.
food_safety: Check coconut-milk labelling; no allergen-free claim.
evidence: Practice: Kerala fish dishes combine coconut milk, tamarind/kokum, turmeric, chile and curry leaf (web-search snippet level). Taco format is a NASHA composition.
estimates_label: All quantities, yields, times and costs are preliminary estimates until a person cooks and measures them. Nothing here has been cooked or tasted.
